Package foms.controller

Class OrdersController

java.lang.Object
foms.controller.OrdersController
public class OrdersController extends Object
The OrdersController class handles the management of orders within the food management system. It provides functionality to create, modify, display, and check the status of orders.
Since:
2024-04-15
